title: chrysolaena oligophylla
intro: Chrysolaena oligophylla, commonly known as the Brazilian plume flower, is a plant species native to the Atlantic coastal region of Brazil. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and stress due to its adaptogenic properties, and its health benefits such as acting as an antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Chrysolaena oligophylla include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce muscle spasms, and improve sleep quality. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
